children.children: One scope selector for the whole panel

State and breakpoint live in one place. Pick hover and every edit below writes hover: classes; a dot on a chip means that scope already holds values. The + offers md, dark, focus, aria-*, group-hover… No more per-row Base chips and trash cans.

children.children: A dot next to a property label means it varies in another scope (here md sets flex-row). Click it to peek and jump. The full per-property override editor still exists — it just opens on demand (board 03) instead of rendering for every row.

children.children: Sections list only what is styled. Dashed ghosts surface the likeliest next properties for the context (a flex child gets min/max/aspect); the section + opens a searchable, keyboard-first menu with everything else. Empty sections collapse to one quiet line.

children.children: Justify × align collapse into one matrix beside direction and gap — one glance instead of four segmented rows. Padding is a box model with a link toggle: linked writes p-4, unlinked writes px-/py- or per-side, mirroring exactly what Tailwind does.
